record_title: Almost BCD forces Banach–Mazur Euclidean cotangent fibers at the sharp square-root scale
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The constants and admissible smallness threshold depend on fiber dimension; the conclusion is almost-everywhere and fiberwise rather than global metric closeness; no optimal Banach-Mazur constant or dimension-free infinite-dimensional analogue is claimed. The motivating almost-BCD preprint is recent, so differently phrased or not-yet-indexed parallel observations remain a residual originality risk.
